studies.title: The tomato
studies.caption: Tomatoes ripen among divided leaves, beginning as green fruit before changing colour. Cultivation in the Americas preceded their long journey into European kitchens.
studies.prompt: Intimate branch-level study of a modest heritage tomato Solanum lycopersicum plant, hairy stems, irregular compound leaves, small yellow star flowers and a cluster of small red and green slightly ribbed tomatoes with green calyx. Earth garden background, no oversized supermarket fruit or people.
